thirty-one-beginners-and-eight-paddles.author: jake
thirty-one-beginners-and-eight-paddles.text: Mel, don't cap it. Thirty-one people wanting to play is the dream. Set it up as a mixer on [Rallio](https://rallio.io/for-coaches/) and let everyone sign up. It draws the rounds across however many courts you've got and rotates the sit-outs, so everyone gets the same time on court and nobody's stood on the side for twenty minutes. And you'll know it's forty before Sunday, not at 2.10. Happy to set it up with you.

the-championships-draw.text: Malcolm, try running the next one as a [knockout comp on Rallio](https://rallio.io/competitions/). You seed the field and it spreads the byes across both halves, then everyone gets the draw on their phone. You can still do it in the bar if you like, just without the hat.

six-weeks-to-play-four-matches.text: I'm the one who sent one message on a Sunday. In my defence it was a long message.

six-weeks-to-play-four-matches.author: jake
six-weeks-to-play-four-matches.text: Terry, have a look at running it as a [Rallio box league](https://rallio.io/box-leagues/). Everyone can see who they still have to play and challenge them from their phone, and scores go in against both names, with the other player confirming. You also see the unplayed matches building up in week three, not on the last Sunday.

six-weeks-to-play-four-matches.text: We tried a rule that any match not played by week four was a double walkover. It worked for exactly one season and then the committee got scared.
